title: Eleutheran Adventurers settle Eleuthera
description: English Puritans led by William Sayle from Bermuda make the first lasting European settlement in the islands.

title: New Providence settled
description: Bermudian settlers found Charles Town on New Providence, the island that becomes the colony's centre.

title: Lords Proprietors granted the Bahamas
description: Charles II grants the islands to the Lords Proprietors of Carolina, whose weak rule leaves them to pirates and wreckers.

title: Charles Town renamed Nassau
description: The capital of New Providence is rebuilt after a Spanish raid and renamed Nassau in honour of William III.

title: Woodes Rogers ends the pirate republic
description: The first royal governor arrives with pardons and executions, breaking the pirates' hold on Nassau.

title: First elected assembly
description: The first elected House of Assembly meets, the start of continuous parliamentary government in the colony.

title: Battle of Nassau
description: American marines briefly occupy Nassau and carry off its gunpowder in the first landing of their new corps.

title: The Bahamas stay British
description: The peace with the new United States leaves the islands with Britain, and thousands of American Loyalists arrive, reshaping the colony.

title: Duke of Windsor becomes governor
description: The former Edward VIII is sent to govern the colony for the rest of the war.

title: Burma Road riot
description: Black construction workers strike and riot over pay, starting the labour movement that leads to majority rule.

title: Hawksbill Creek Agreement
description: The government grants a private company broad powers to develop Freeport, creating the country's second city.

title: General strike
description: A six-week strike that begins with taxi drivers shuts down the tourist trade and wins labour reforms.

title: Women vote for the first time
description: Bahamian women vote in a general election for the first time after a decade of suffrage campaigning.

title: New constitution
description: A new constitution gives the colony cabinet government and full internal self-rule.

title: Majority rule
description: Lynden Pindling's Progressive Liberal Party ends the white merchant elite's hold on office and forms the first black-led government.

title: Independence
description: The Bahamas becomes an independent state within the Commonwealth.

title: FNM ends the Pindling era
description: Hubert Ingraham's Free National Movement wins the election, ending 25 years of Pindling governments.

title: Hurricane Dorian
description: The strongest hurricane on record in the Bahamas stalls over Abaco and Grand Bahama, killing scores and destroying whole towns.
